entities.name: Measurement Reporting Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE to report measurement results based on configured measurement configurations and trigger conditions.

entities.name: VarMeasConfig
entities.description: Configuration container for measurement parameters including measIdList, reportConfig, and measObject configurations.

entities.name: VarMeasReportList
entities.description: List containing measurement reporting entries including cellsTriggeredList, numberOfReportsSent, and other reporting state information.

entities.name: reportConfig
entities.description: Configuration defining reporting criteria including reportType, event triggers, periodical settings, and measurement parameters.

entities.name: measObject
entities.description: Object defining the measurement target including frequency, cell parameters, and technology-specific configurations.

entities.name: Timer T312
entities.description: Timer used in measurement reporting when useT312 is set to true and T310 is running for the corresponding SpCell.

entities.name: Timer T321
entities.description: Timer used for reportCGI measurements, stopped when SIB1 is acquired or cell is detected as not transmitting SIB1.

entities.name: Timer T322
entities.description: Timer used for SFTD measurements, stopped when quantity to be reported becomes available for each requested pair of PCell and NR cell.

entities.name: Periodical Reporting Timer
entities.description: Timer for periodic measurement reporting, stopped when cellsTriggeredList becomes empty.

entities.name: Event Entry Condition
entities.description: Condition that triggers measurement reporting when fulfilled for applicable cells, L2 U2N Relay UEs, or transmission resource pools.

entities.name: Event Leaving Condition
entities.description: Condition that removes cells from triggered list when fulfilled, potentially triggering reportOnLeave reporting.

entities.name: AS Security Activated
entities.description: Precondition that must be satisfied before UE performs measurement reporting procedures.

relations.description: Measurement reporting procedure uses configuration from VarMeasConfig.
Procedure maintains and updates state in VarMeasReportList.
Procedure execution requires AS security to be activated.
Fulfillment of event entry condition triggers measurement reporting procedure.
Fulfillment of event leaving condition may trigger measurement reporting procedure when reportOnLeave is true.
Procedure starts timer T312 when useT312 is true and conditions are met.
Procedure stops timer T321 when SIB1 is acquired or cell is detected as not transmitting SIB1.
Procedure stops timer T322 when quantity to be reported becomes available for each requested pair of PCell and NR cell.
Procedure stops periodical reporting timer when cellsTriggeredList becomes empty.
reportConfig defines the event entry conditions for measurement reporting.
reportConfig defines the event leaving conditions for measurement reporting.
